Camphill for its entire history has stayed in 1 place, northern Vespuria. Since camphill's monarchy became constitutional, we stayed in Northern Vespuria. Since we combined our monarchy with [nation]Akhratia[/nation]s, we've stayed in one place. But now, we will expand, we will move into former Anrakan Land and take over, It is time for camphill to grow! 

"Peace is, much better then killing people, I assumed the press knew that." -Alexander Arramont, former king of Camphill.... There is a reason Alexander is dead, he was weak, he stayed in one country his entire life, he hated war and pain too much, well by today's government standards. He was pathetic, he was a weak ruler, he was a coward.

But our new leader, our young Queen and Empress, is daring and strong. She has the strength to conquer, to take over, and to move. She is a bright young mind, and has plenty of time to do as she likes.

The conservative government in camphill has won the election for its second time in a row. Our empress and the government has teamed up to expand camphill land area and population. Though the population of camphill is used to being at peace for most of its history. They will riot and break things, and make a lot of noise. But our government must get though it for the future of camphill. 

Ljaná the 3rd's speech to the people "People of Camphill, congrats on the Conservatives for winning the presidential election. I support the government for any policies they will have. Now everyone, we must do our best for camphill to prosper."

[quote=oceanice_republics;60233697][i][u][b]The Fall of Welkis City[/b][/u]

[b]After 3 Days, 15 Hours[/b]

Welkis Undertake

The once-proud port city was now a smoldering battlefield, its docks cratered from artillery, its skyline fractured by rising plumes of smoke. ULR armored columns pressed relentlessly through shattered boulevards, their tracks grinding over broken glass and spent casings. The last organized elements of the Oceanice Republic Armed Forces had fallen back into the inner city, collapsing block by block, their loyalist militias fighting desperate rear-guard actions.

But the most vicious fighting was not between armies. Across Welkis, rebel partisans clashed with human loyalist militias, alleyways turning into ambush zones, entire neighborhoods erupting into fratricide. The once-bustling fish markets and warehouses of the port were now warzones, claimed and reclaimed in hours.
Inside the governors palace, a battered colonial structure overlooking the harbor, Governor Hikman Eikira convened his final council. Tired, his face lined from sleepless nights, he spoke words that echoed across every surviving loyalist radio frequency

I offer peaceful surrender. But mark this, if the United Lavian Republic will not allow my men and me to depart aboard the cargo plane waiting at Strip 95, then you will leave me no choice. The Republic still stands. One of our last submarines remains loyal. It carries the means to end an island, perhaps two. I will not see Welkis fall without consequence.

The threat was chilling. ULR intelligence confirmed his words. The Oceanice Republics dwindling strategic arsenal still counted one nuclear submarine unaccounted for. Whether it was bluff or truth, none dared dismiss it.

At the siege perimeter, ULR officers weighed the ultimatum. Commanders wanted total victory, no negotiations, no escapes for collaborators. But the higher council in Makinar understood the stakes. If Eikira made good on his threat, tens of thousands of Lavian soldiers and civilians on nearby islands could be annihilated.

Inside Welkis, the situation grew even more chaotic. Loyalist troops, emboldened by the governors broadcast, fought harder, believing the threat of nuclear reprisal might force ULRs withdrawal. Rebels, on the other hand, intensified their attacks, desperate to crush the loyalists before the ultimatum forced a stalemate.

[b][u]Last Days of the Republic - The Capitulation of Wellgoes Isle - Post 4[/u][/b]
[i]Three days later, the island stood silent. Guns no longer rang out through the streets and wilderness of Wellgoes; no more aircraft screeched above its airspace loaded with explosives to crater and kill. Enemies stood within feet of each other, yet none would fire. The weary and exhausted Hikman Eikira stood in front of the general who brought the downfall of his island and the ruination of their society. Bitterly, he saluted the general who did the same back, and the loading of a sole C-220 began. Soldiers brought their few possessions in foot lockers, and the Governor himself brought only a few clothes and necessities, along with his family. 

The soldiers who werent high enough rank to place upon the plane were shown to one of the sole surviving ships in the capitols harbour, captained by the commander of the once prideful Wellgoes squadron. Soldiers were allowed to take more on the ship as they tried to fill the empty space where their brothers in arms would have not days earlier. The island and its SRBM bunkers in Lavian hands caused rejoice in some of the civilian population, others left worried or confused on where the island would go after the republic crumbles and rises anew.

The rebuilding took place hours after the old government forces left. Army engineers and civilian workers quickly worked to put up replacements for buildings ravaged by war, and imports of food stores quickly came flowing in. Leftover military trucks were taken and repurposed as haulers for supplies, military helicopters were stripped of their weapons and turned into medical evac units, providing needed aid to smaller towns and remote communities. The battles for Berlienwerk and Wellgoes were over, and elections were to be held soon for a new republic born from the ashes of struggle and suppression, promising full democracy and equal rights. 

While the isle would remain in Lavian hands, Oceanic citizens still received election ballots to fill out and to be delivered to the new government. It would only be a matter of time till a new leader was chosen and diplomacy would begin to return Wellgoes to familiarity and monotony. History would never forget, and neither would the residents. Scars would remain for years, battle sites deemed as historic and protected, wrecks and abandoned vehicles slowly rediscovered after their abandonment. The last days of a republic over, and the new days of one only beginning.[/i]

Nordiheim officials and its minister of war is happy to anounce the massivly amended and expanded resource and military vehicle deal with The Empire of [nation]Italian dutch[/nation] after the compleation of its signing yesterday night.

This deal not only expands its trade section from a resourse deal of Coal for Copper into a larger general trade deal, but also a large military contract for the purchase of Nordiheimian military vehicles.
These vehicles are the IFV Emu 2-A and the BCV Emu Herder wich will be delivered over the next 16-17 months.
With a bulck delivery of about a fourth of them allready in the process of being sent to the Ostland harbour of Hadanger and loaded into cargo ships for delivery, the Nordiheimian military complex are abuzz with the sound of continued construction and assembly of Emu hulls and turrets to meet the large order over the next 16 months.

Many civilians are also curious to taste the many cheeses and beverages that the nation of Italian dutch creates, as they have mostly only heard about them.

[b][u]The Cheese Board deal[/u][/b]

[b]A amended and expanded trade and resource deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Empire of Italian dutch[/b]
[i]====================================================[/i]

[i][u]With this trade deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Italian Dutch agree to adhere to the following points:[/u][/i]
[i][u]_C__________H__________E__________E__________S__________E_[/u][/i]
[b][u]Military Vehicle Purchase Section[/u][/b]
[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to Sell a tottal of 1000 units of Emu 2-A (IFV) and 100 units of Emu Herder (BCV) to Italian dutch to use in their military.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] An initial bulk delivery of 250 units of Emu 2-A and 25 units of Emu Herder will be delivered over the immidiate month.

[b][u]1.e:[/u][/b] Italian dutch will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any of the Emu 2-A or Emu Herder to other nations without first getting permission from the council of Nordiheim with the exeption of active members of the THEP.

[quote=elnire;60234803][b]The Astorian Journal[/b]

The country recently had parlementary elections. The results have been released today but... Elnire got into a situation where it never was before.

[spoiler= The election results]
[b]72%[/b] of the person who can vote voted (voting is compulsory here)

[b]Socialist Party[/b]: 24% of the votes (63/300 seats)

[b]Liberal Party[/b]: 31% of the votes (93/300 seats)

[b]Christian Democrats[/b]: 14% of the votes (42/300 seats)

[b]Conservative Party[/b]: 34% of the votes (102/300 seats)

(These numbers don't take into account the so called "nothing vote" which were at 32%)

To be able to do pretty much anything, you need half the seats plus one (151 seats) to agree with what you're doing. So, the ruling coalition, is a coalition called [b]"The Left"[/b] composed of the [b]Liberal Party[/b] and the [b]Socialist Party[/b] (whose seats add up to 156).
[/spoiler]

[spoiler= The situation]
The Elnirean Constitution of 1774 states that "The Prime Minister shall be chosen by the Monarch and be from the ruling party or coalition in the Parlement". This article never posed problem because the biggest party was either already rulling, or in the ruling coalition. But today, the biggest party (the "Conservative Party") isn't in the ruling coalition ("The Left").

The King has to appoint a prime minister, but he doesn't know from which side of the political spectrum shall be the prime minister and everyone is confused on how a so ambiguous article was written in the constitution. Each side wants a prime minister from their side (I know surprising right?). 

The constitutional council was informed of the situation and the whole country is waiting for a response. [/spoiler][/quote]

[b]The Astorian Journal[/b]

The country keeps sinking into the political crisis as the Constitutional Council gave it's answer.

"After further study of the article of the constitution, we concluded that it's up to the king to decide who the prime minister will be. He can choose whoever he wants as long as it's a proposition of the biggest party (the Conservative Party) or the ruling coalition (the "Left")." -The Head of the Constitutional Counsil

The King then decided to make the people vote for the prime minister but the vote was vetoed by the constitutional council as it was seen as unconstitutional (as said, the king shall appoint a prime minister, not the people).

After a few hours, the king appointed "Maksimo Basman" (candidate proposed by the "Left" coalition) as prime minister.

The Conservative Party accused the king of, "once again favoring the left", as the king already refused to give his royal approval on multiple socially conservative laws pushed by the party (the royal approval is mandatory to pass laws in Elnire). The King replied by "The prime minister should to be from the ruling entity".

This even further reduces the king's approval rating.
